sourceInputs: not provided beyond the user's request for a goblin sled mount concept
permissionContext: The user supplied /mnt/e/rocketsled.png and asked for a World of ClaudeCraft goblin sled mount based on it.
shippingPolicy: The source sheet and transient crops are not committed or shipped in this design pass. The source hash, admission result, observed construction, and design boundary are recorded here without inventing missing generation lineage.

admissionGate.semanticSuitability: pass: one coherent vehicle design with hero, orthographic-like, top-clearance, detail, and rear views

kept: low wide sled silhouette on two long straight runners with shallow upturned tips
open central tufted seat with no handlebars or visible controls
two low side-mounted rockets with banded red bodies, dark nozzle stacks, fins, and orange exhaust
low central banded fuel or bomb tank behind the rider
layered timber deck, dark iron brackets, rivet rows, pipes, and ramshackle goblin construction
green goblin skull or mask ornament centered on the prow
worn blood-red, dark iron, aged wood, brown leather, muted green bone, and orange glow palette
clear rider zone shown by the top-view diagram
excluded: the concept sheet title, labels, arrows, border, construction diagram, and other presentation graphics
literal smoke, sparks, and painted flame geometry baked into the vehicle GLB
any readable text, watermark, manufacturer identity, or exact source pixels
steering, brakes, handlebars, control levers, or other controls the concept explicitly omits
wheels, a puller creature, a carrier rig, skinning, and baked locomotion clips
real explosive or projectile gameplay behavior
originalTreatment: project-authored underside frame inferred from the admitted side and rear views
project-authored skull-and-bones markings without text or copied raster pixels
independent procedural metal, wood, and leather PBR fields rather than extracting baked lighting from the concept
runtime pooled exhaust effect driven from named nozzle sockets
runtime procedural bob and terrain tilt owned by a mount-specific render module
continuous held rocket-loop audio with explicit dismount cleanup

hero.description: Large front-left three-quarter vehicle view in the upper-left and center of the sheet.
hero.role: canonical silhouette, palette, runner length, rocket placement, seat, tank, and prow ornament

front.description: Front view in the multi-angle row.
front.role: runner spacing, rocket symmetry, and prow width

side.description: Left profile in the multi-angle row.
side.role: runner curvature, tank and seat height, rocket length, and chassis stance

rear.description: Rear view in the multi-angle row plus the larger fired-up rear detail.
rear.role: nozzle construction, exhaust spacing, tank placement, and rear frame width

top.description: Top rider-clearance diagram at the lower left.
top.role: safe rider footprint, shoulder and head clearance, rocket offsets, and tank position

rocketDetail.description: Rocket body and nozzle close-ups in the upper-right detail grid.
rocketDetail.role: barrel bands, rivets, conical nose, nozzle rings, paint wear, and glow core

seatDetail.description: Seat and backrest close-up in the upper-right detail grid.
seatDetail.role: tufted pad segmentation, frame thickness, and open rider volume

tankDetail.description: Fuel or bomb tank close-up in the upper-right detail grid.
tankDetail.role: band rhythm, top caps, valves, side marking, and end construction

detailCloseups.description: Combined close-up grid covering rocket, nozzle, tank, runner tip, mount, and seat.

acceptanceRationale: The sheet presents one unambiguous target vehicle rather than a scene.
Multiple consistent views expose the silhouette, rear, side, top clearance, and identity-critical assemblies.
The design is well suited to deterministic primitive, profile-extrude, tube, and instanced-fastener construction.
Hidden underside geometry can be approximated without compromising visible identity.
